data.name: エターナルハンド
data.detailed_description:
Note: This game uses generative AI, so playing it consumes in-game points. Points are a paid item.

You receive 50,000 points as a first-time bonus, which is enough for roughly 15 battles.

(For reference: text generation costs around 1,500 pt per match, and image generation around 600 pt per image. Image generation can be turned off.)

(A detailed price list is at the bottom of this page.)

A novel-style game that could only have been born now

Eternal Hand delivers a completely new experience by combining text-generation AI with image-generation AI. On the battle screen the story is written out as though it were a novel, with illustrations generated to match each scene.

There are no preset choices like those in a typical visual novel. You simply type whatever you want to say or do, and the story unfolds freely from there.

Over 1,000 recruitable monsters! The RPG Mode players call a rabbit hole

RPG Mode is a solo-only mode built as the entry point to the game.

The core loop is straightforward: answer a personality quiz to create yourself, form a party, take monster subjugation requests from the request board, and earn experience and rewards. What sets it apart is that every subjugation target can be recruited as a companion - and there are more than 1,000 of them!

Every monster was designed to be one of a kind, with no duplicates. Build the party that suits your taste from among them.

Create characters with no limits and battle parties from all over

One of the biggest draws of Eternal Hand is the Arena. Restrictions have been stripped away as far as possible, so you can create characters with any appearance and any background you like, upload them as a party, and battle the parties other players have uploaded.

Thanks to an active community, just under 2,000 parties have been uploaded so far.

A Scenario Mode deep enough to build a short RPG in

Scenario Mode comes with long-term memory, so you can form any party you like and play through a wide range of scenarios. Best of all, you can create scenarios yourself and share them. Simple ones are easy to make, and for anyone who wants to go further, scenes, images and flags give you more than enough to build something on the scale of a short RPG. There is also automatic scenario generation, so you can jump straight into the kind of story you feel like playing.

Price list for in-game points (paid item)

9,700 pt 200 JPY

48,500 pt 1,000 JPY

145,500 pt 3,000 JPY

242,500 pt 5,000 JPY

485,000 pt 10,000 JPY

Eternal Hand Streaming and Video Guidelines

This document sets out what is permitted when streaming or posting videos of the Steam version of Eternal Hand.

1) What is permitted

The following are permitted for individuals and companies alike, whether commercial or non-commercial.

  • Let's plays, commentary, reviews, guides, analysis, clips and highlight edits

  • Live streaming, including publishing the archive

  • Posting screenshots, including use as thumbnails

  • Monetization through platform features such as YouTube Partner or Twitch
    No prior application or notice is required.

2) Spoilers

Because this game is not built around a fixed storyline, spoiler warnings are not required.
(That said, you are welcome to add one if you would like to be considerate of your audience.)

3) Credit (a request)

Where possible, please include the following in your video description, stream summary, or similar.

Game title: Eternal Hand

4) Handling generated content and user input (important)

What appears on screen can change dramatically depending on user input and how play unfolds.
Please keep the following in mind regarding the text, images and logs shown during your stream.

  • If anything inappropriate, or anything that may infringe someone's rights, appears on screen, please handle it by masking it, blurring it, or cutting the section in question.

  • Please avoid anything that would expose third-party copyrighted works, trademarks or characters, the likeness of a real person, or personal information.

5) Prohibited uses

  • Content whose main purpose is to break the law, offend public order and morals, incite discrimination, or defame others

  • Cheating, unauthorized tools, modification, reverse engineering, exploiting vulnerabilities, or encouraging or showcasing any of these

  • Extracting and distributing in-game data, redistributing it as assets, or uploading it for the purpose of reposting

  • Impersonating the official account, or wording that invites confusion with official material

  • Streaming that violates the terms of the platform you are using

6) Disclaimer

The developer and publisher cannot accept responsibility for problems arising from your streams or posts, such as demonetization, infringement claims, or disputes with third parties. Please proceed at your own discretion and at your own risk.

7) Revisions

These guidelines may be changed without notice whenever necessary. Please always refer to the latest version.
